items.q: I remember doing gigs in high school with a local society band, one of the better ones, in New Haven, Connecticut, about a half hour from where I lived. A guy named Pat Dorn.

ctx.x: Well go ahead, because I have my own variation.

Well this is fifth grade, and I’m not really serious about it. I had it, and they give you a school instrument. So sometimes I practiced, sometimes I didn’t, and I tried to get my mother to sign one of those weeks where I didn’t and she said, “I’m not going to sign this.” So I said, “I’m going to get in a heap of trouble, come on.” And this was probably halfway through the year, so she said, “No, deal with it.” So I said, “Well then I quit.” And she said, “You can’t quit.” And I said, “Why not?” She said “you…
Do you remember what the first paying gig you ever had was?
